readings.Career: Underneath, you do your calmest work closest to pressure, because the deadlines that grind other people turn into steady output in your hands.
readings.Health: Comfort is what protects you, because good food and work with your hands turn pressure into something you can use.

shishen_zhi_sha.fused_line: In you this runs close to the surface, and you turn pressure into calm almost as soon as it lands.

readings.Career: Your boldest ideas and your patience for study also feed each other, and you grow braver in public with every qualification you earn.
readings.Mind: You also learn best when you can show what you learn, and you turn every course you finish into something you can say out loud.

shang_guan_pei_yin.fused_line: In you the two never pull apart, and you rarely have to choose between your talent and your training.

readings.Mind: You also think so long about a thing that you miss the moment to make it, and you keep a drawer of nearly finished work.
readings.Career: You also polish your work in private until the moment to show it has passed, and you lose more chances by not finishing than by failing.
readings.Health: In your heaviest thinking seasons you also forget to eat and sleep properly, and your body tells you before your mind admits it.

xiao_shen_duo_shi.fused_line: In you this pull is constant, and you feel the tug between thinking and finishing almost every day.

readings.Career: You also keep correcting the very structures you climb, and you do your brightest work wherever the rules are loosest.

shang_guan_jian_guan.fused_line: In you this runs deep, and you have argued with your own position since your first job.

readings.Career: Underneath, you come out of every hard stretch at work more senior than you went in, and the pattern grows stronger with age.
readings.Growth: Underneath, you grow most through the years that weigh on you, and you have left every heavy stretch more skilled than you entered it.
readings.Mind: Underneath, you turn pressure into understanding, and the hardest years of your life are the ones that taught you how to think.

sha_yin_xiang_sheng.fused_line: In you this works fast, and you learn from pressure in the same week it arrives.

readings.Wealth: You lose money most easily where you share it with friends and family, and you also find your safety net among those same people.

bi_jie_duo_cai.fused_line: In you this runs close to home, and you rarely own anything that is only yours.

readings.Wealth: Underneath, what you make turns into money more easily for you than for most, and you earn most from the work that feels like play.
readings.Career: You are also paid best for the work you would do unpaid, and you grow your income by making more rather than by climbing.

shi_shang_sheng_cai.fused_line: In you the gap is short, and you are paid in the same season that you make.

readings.Career: Underneath, your earnings keep turning into standing, and you rarely ask for the title your results have already earned.
readings.Wealth: You also turn money into position, and you feel richer when a gain comes with respect than when it comes alone.

cai_guan_xiang_sheng.fused_line: In you the two are tightly bound, and you find every gain arguing quietly for your next title.

readings.Career: You also find your mentors inside the structures you join, and your name gathers weight the slow and lasting way.
readings.Mind: Even so, you learn well inside a frame like a school or a discipline, and you keep studying long after the course has ended.

guan_yin_xiang_sheng.fused_line: In you the two move together, and you rise in rank and in learning at once.
